architectural_assessment.approach_summary: Penerapan arsitektur ERP MGBOS modular: (1) Migrasi Supabase aditif untuk pricing rules, promo engine, BOM, dan margin snapshot; (2) RPC function calculate_order_hpp dan get_effective_pricing; (3) Integrasi dynamic pricing & WhatsApp assisted intake di storefront apps/teestock.

blast_radius_mapping.database_invariants: Migrasi bersifat strictly additive. Tidak merusak skema app.orders eksisting (order_type CUSTOM_B2B dan RETAIL_DIRECT tetap valid, ditambahkan opsi CREATOR_COLLAB dan RESELLER_DROPSHIP). RLS membatasi pembacaan HPP rahasia hanya untuk service_role / authenticated admin.
blast_radius_mapping.downstream_risk: Rendah. Tidak ada breaking change terhadap modul custom atelier atau B2B invoicing eksisting.

pragmatic_tradeoff.full_commercial_scope: Sistem ERP lengkap dengan multi-warehouse inventory, automated supplier PO trigger, multi-tiered volume discounts, and fully automated Midtrans/Xendit payment reconciliation.
pragmatic_tradeoff.recommended_20_percent_scope: Vertical slice 80/20: Database schema pricing rules + BOM HPP calculation + margin snapshot + WhatsApp assisted checkout with dynamic price & promo code support.
deferred_capabilities: Automated procurement purchase order generation to fabric suppliers
Dynamic real-time courier shipping API integration (Biteship/RajaOngkir)

negative_controls.idempotency_guarantee: Kalkulasi HPP dan snapshot margin dieksekusi sekali per order_id dengan unique constraint untuk mencegah duplikasi pencatatan profit.
negative_controls.tenant_auth_isolation: Setiap record pricing_rules, BOM, dan promotions terikat secara ketat pada organization_id dengan RLS terisolasi.
negative_test_scenarios: Mencegah customer publik membaca tabel HPP dan data biaya modal melalui API publik
Mencegah penerapan kode promo yang sudah kedaluwarsa atau melebihi batas kuota pemakaian
Mencegah reservasi stok negatif ketika inventory_items available = 0

builder_dispatch_plan.estimated_execution: WP-01: Database migrations and RPC functions (15 mins); WP-02: Storefront dynamic pricing and WhatsApp intake integration (20 mins).

owner_decision_required: Konfirmasi eksekusi 80/20 vertical slice melalui Work Package WP-01 (Database Migration) dan WP-02 (Storefront Integration).
